name: comp_bass_slap
description: Slap bass — fast attack to level uneven thumb hits, high ratio for consistency
notes: 8ms attack catches dynamic variation between hits while preserving the slap click. 5:1 ratio aggressively levels out the loudest hits. 60ms release resets fast enough between slaps at 100-160 BPM. Threshold -20dB catches even the quieter hits. Use instead of comp_bass_di when slap technique is uneven.
